findings.message: Rule-bearing legacy code in Claims.Rules.fastTrackCeiling matches no observation and has rule-bearing constructs without accepted authority (ast analyzer). Superseded authority: numeric literal 2500.00 (line 18): value 2500.00 = DEC-CL02.p1 (superseded by DEC-CL05, same form) and no accepted parameter has the same form. The code still carries a superseded decision's value. Question for Claims Governance: which accepted record, if any, authorizes it? New work must not reuse it until answered; the legacy code is left unchanged.

Rule-bearing legacy code in Claims.Rules.initialReserve matches no observation and has rule-bearing constructs without accepted authority (ast analyzer). No accepted authority: numeric literal 2000.00 (line 28): value 2000.00 equals no declared parameter of an accepted or superseded record. Question for praxis-intake: which accepted record, if any, authorizes it? New work must not reuse it until answered; the legacy code is left unchanged.
